1. What is the Momcozy Autumn Sale?
The Autumn Sale runs October 1–8, 2026, overlapping National Breastfeeding Week (October 1–7). Shop the offers on this page while they last.
2. What discounts are available during the Autumn Sale?
You can save up to 60% off selected best-seller deals, 20% off eligible items sitewide with a code, and 25% off when you Mix & Match any 3 eligible items (no code). Selected products also include a gift with purchase, and eligible strollers include a free accessory. The up to 60% offer is the highest discount during this event.
3. How do I use codes BDAS60 and BDAS20?
Copy the code on the product card, then paste it at checkout.
BDAS60 — matching deep-discount deals (up to 60% off).
BDAS20 — eligible sitewide 20% off items, and selected gifts with purchase.
For bundles, use the code on the card: BDAS25, or BDAS22.
One promo code per order. If a code does not apply, that item is not part of this promotion.
4. Can I combine promo codes or use a code with Mix & Match?
No. Only one promo code per order. Mix & Match is automatic when 3 eligible items are in your cart and does not need a code. It generally cannot be combined with a BDAS code on the same order—use whichever offer saves more. Gift cards can be used with a promo.
5. How does Mix & Match (Any 3 for 25% Off) work?
Add any 3 eligible products to your cart and 25% off applies automatically. No code needed. Bottle washers and sterilizers such as KleanPal Pro Bottle Washer, the 3-Layer Fast Bottle Sterilizer and Dryer, and the 8-in-1 Baby Bottle Steam Sterilizer are excluded. If the discount does not appear, check the on-page rules.
6. How does the gift with purchase work?
Selected items offer an Autumn gift with purchase when you use BDAS20 at checkout. Eligible strollers also include a free premium accessory. Gifts are available while supplies last; if a gift does not appear, that product may not be part of this offer.
7. Do you ship across Canada? Is shipping free?
Yes. We ship across Canada. Orders $35.99 CAD and over ship free; orders under that have a $9.00 CAD shipping fee. Allow 1–2 business days to process, then about 2–10 business days in transit (rural addresses can take longer).
8. When is National Breastfeeding Week in Canada?
Canada observes National Breastfeeding Week from October 1–7 each year—the 40th week of the year, marking a full-term pregnancy. The 2026 focus is Strengthen What Works: Breastfeeding for a Sustainable Start in Life. This Autumn Sale is timed to overlap that week.
9. Is National Breastfeeding Week the same as World Breastfeeding Week in August?
No. World Breastfeeding Week is o

bserved internationally in August (August 1–7). Canada’s National Breastfeeding Week is October 1–7. This page is for the Canadian October week and the Autumn Sale, not a rerun of August breastfeeding promotions.
10. Where can I find breastfeeding support on this page?
Scroll to Why can breastfeeding be so hard for findings from 2,000 moms with Talker Research, then Breastfeeding Support That Stays With You. Watch Feeding Guidance, At Your Fingertips for expert-led tips, and read the Canada-focused articles: Returning to Work While Breastfeeding in Canada, Combination Feeding in Canada, and How to Store Breast Milk in Canada. Every feeding journey is different; if you have a medical or supply concern, speak with your midwife, public health nurse, or an IBCLC.
